# Which of your gigs actually pay?

> DJ gig profit calculator for mobile DJs and event entertainers. Enter packages, event hours, setup time and gig costs to see profit per hour worked, the price that hits your target, and direct clients versus a lead marketplace versus an agency.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
